protocol.source: Hand-authored French narrative and adversarial fixtures; no personal manuscripts. Not a population sample.
protocol.partition: Paired variants and named subjects stay within one split; former 42-case corpus is historical.
protocol.validation: One inference pass after policy freeze; failures are reported, never used for retuning.
protocol.metrics: Exact label + Unicode codepoint start/end; micro and per-category, raw vs model accepted vs all published, negative-case false displays.
